name: Danco Medical Systems
old_description: Danco Medical Systems has specialized in pharmacy and laboratory design, workflow, and modular casework since 1972. Our design expertise and modular solutions will maximize your workspace and create an efficient environment conducive to your individual department’s needs.
about:
Danco Medical Systems, a family-owned business headquartered in Tipp City, Ohio, was founded in 1962 and has operated under family ownership since 1972. The company began by focusing on pharmacy and laboratory design, workflow optimization, and modular casework solutions for healthcare facilities.

Today, Danco provides a range of services including hospital pharmacy design, modular casework fabrication, IV hood selection and installation, USP 797/800 cleanroom configuration, and room sanitization systems. The firm also supplies a complete line of pharmacy cabinets, refrigerator/freezers, carts, and medication carousels from various manufacturers. Over its history, Danco has designed and equipped hundreds of facilities, supporting unit dose programs, pharmacy automation, and regulatory compliance.

The company serves hospital pharmacies, medical and dental offices, and laboratory environments. Its customers include institutions implementing USP Chapter 797 and 800 standards, adding automation to existing pharmacies, or building new cleanroom spaces. Danco’s design expertise is applied to both new construction and renovation projects across the healthcare sector.

Danco states that its mission is to deliver cost-effective, high-quality medical, pharmaceutical, and laboratory products, design, and services at the customer’s convenience. The company emphasizes its design expertise and modular solutions as a way to maximize workspace efficiency and create functional environments tailored to each department’s needs.
